Messages.Author: legb...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Michael won at Louisa's house on monday and during the game the following
interesting situation came up:

i had a load of obf/OBF vamps who were all empty due to an emergency
Tribute to the Master. The first one hunted and was blocked by Sam - an
inconclusive combat resulted. Then i Hidden Lurkered another of my empty
vamps [Basil] onto Sam's blocker and hit the blocker for a cheeky one
point of damage. The rules check bit of this post is to ask whether this
was legit - i think it was, since HL is not an action, but an action
modifier, and nothing stops empty vamps from playing action modifiers.

The deck idea arises from wishing that i'd had a few more Disguised
Weapons and, well, weapons. Wouldn't it be fun to have Strained Vitae
Supply or palla Grande in play with a deck that deliberately wore your
own obf/aus vamps down to not-very-much/no blood? Then if other people
hunted you would block them and Fast React if necessary; and if people
blocked YOUR vampires hunting you would HL and smite them with something
pointy or flamy. Bit of dominate for grave-robbing, maybe ... spot of
Rotshreck, perhaps ... sprinkle with parsley and butter, bake in a
moderate oven for 20 minutes kinda thing?

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/
